Draft editing, shared work text, immutable revisions/restores, review preview and recorded outbound messages retain Cc. Full regression passes; legitimate provider routing, non-PLAIN authentication and delivery reconciliation remain unproven or open as recorded. Tokens never substitute for passwords or fall back after rejection.
